mainEntity.name: When should my business consider AI Overview optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider AI Overview optimization now, as Google's AI Overviews are becoming a standard feature in search results. If your goal is to maintain or improve visibility, reach users directly in search, and establish your brand as an authority, optimizing for AI is essential. Proactive optimization ensures your content is prepared for current and future AI-driven search environments, preventing potential loss of organic visibility.
